Starting from zero dollars? These seven money steps work best in this exact order.
One: find your number. Know what's left after your bills.
Two: build a starter emergency fund, so one surprise doesn't wreck you.
Three: kill credit card debt. At around twenty-one percent interest, paying it off beats almost any investment.
Four: grab your full 401(k) match. That's free money.
Six: buy the whole market with a low-cost index fund.
Seven: automate it, and leave it alone.
Skip a step, and the plan breaks. The full guide is on our channel.
